parsed_entries.requirement: An aggrieved party may file an appeal with the Appellate Tribunal within thirty days of receiving a direction, decision, or order from the Authority.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify the existence of a time-bound appeal mechanism within thirty days for appeals to the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applies to appeals by the Central Government, State Government, local authority, or aggrieved person.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the procedural requirement for filing an appeal within thirty days.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must send a copy of every order made by it to the parties to the dispute or the appeal and to the Authority.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Appellate Tribunal provides copies of its orders to all relevant parties and the Authority.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applies to all orders made by the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause mandates the dissemination of orders to all affected parties and the Authority.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal may entertain an appeal even after the expiry of the thirty-day period if there is sufficient cause for the delay.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify whether the Appellate Tribunal allows late appeals with sufficient cause.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applies to appeals filed after the thirty-day period.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause provides for an exception to the thirty-day appeal deadline under specific conditions.
